meta.name: oiv_prod_usd (optimism) - MultiSend unwrappers on the exec Roles Modifier
meta.description: setTransactionUnwrapper on the exec Roles Modifier 0xd8e63D2ca7A098E2B939BF4733e94C5768D3B966, for both Safe MultiSend contracts. Owner-only; execute from the OIV Safe 0x8b884f80B3B839F52b6cE168f133e7a5D1f0A537. A Roles Modifier permission-checks one call at a time, so without an unwrap adapter a batched multiSend(bytes) is an opaque delegatecall it cannot decompose and rejects wholesale. The kUSD stack was deployed by the pre-fix KpkOivFactory on FIVE chains (ethereum, optimism, gnosis, base, arbitrum) at IDENTICAL modifier addresses, and all three modifiers on every one of them are missing both registrations - verified on-chain 2026-07-24. Execute the matching file on each chain; this one is optimism (chainId 10). The sub and manager Roles Modifiers are owned by the Manager Safe - see oiv-prod-usd-unwrappers-optimism-manager-safe.json.
